build_VisionTransformer2_backbone: build a VisionTransformer2 backbone model with ConvNeXt encoder and transformer layers for vision tasks
create_VisionTransformer2_with_arch: create a VisionTransformer2 model using the sapiens2_0.3b architecture preset from the arch zoo
run_VisionTransformer2_forward: run forward pass on image tensor through VisionTransformer2 to extract cls_token or feature map output
freeze_VisionTransformer2_stages: freeze early stages of VisionTransformer2 backbone by setting frozen_stages parameter for transfer learning
resize_VisionTransformer2_pos_embed: resize position embeddings in VisionTransformer2 to match different input image sizes during model loading
